subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: When an exec-like tool fails and no user-facing response is delivered, should OpenClaw surface the tool-error warning, the incomplete-turn fallback, or a single merged message?
rationale: Current main intentionally suppresses some exec-like warnings and lastToolError blocks the payloadCount=0 fallback, so changing this needs a chosen product contract to avoid either silent turns or duplicate/noisy warnings.

options.title: Define one merged no-reply error surface
options.body: Route no-reply exec/tool failures through one canonical warning or fallback path and update payload/incomplete-turn tests around that contract.

options.title: Keep warning suppression and fix only provider placeholders
options.body: Treat the remaining silent-turn behavior as intentional and narrow this issue to provider replay state, leaving incomplete-turn behavior unchanged.

options.title: Split into canonical issues
options.body: Make #96857 own placeholder/session poisoning and #97324 own incomplete-turn replay safety, then close this only after both contracts are explicitly covered.

recommendation.title: Define one merged no-reply error surface
recommendation.body: Route no-reply exec/tool failures through one canonical warning or fallback path and update payload/incomplete-turn tests around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent terminal-state and replay semantics work is closest to the warning/fallback contract choice.
